description: This Java class defines an immutable data structure 'TopicData' that manages a set of subscribers (represented by ActorRef objects) for a specific topic, along with its hash representation. It provides static factory methods for creation, methods for modifying subscribers, and utility methods for accessing and exporting the subscribers and hashes. The class is marked as not thread-safe.

classes.name: TopicData
classes.description: A final generic class that holds a set of subscriber references and a hash representation of the topic, with methods for managing subscribers and retrieving data.

methods.name: firstSubscriber
methods.description: Creates a new TopicData instance with a single initial subscriber and associated hashes.

methods.name: addSubscriber
methods.description: Adds a new subscriber to the set of subscribers, returning true if the set was modified.

methods.name: removeSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a subscriber from the set, returning true if the set was modified.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if there are no subscribers.

methods.name: getHashes
methods.description: Returns the hashes associated with the topic.

methods.name: streamSubscribers
methods.description: Provides a Stream stream of the current subscribers.

methods.name: exportSubscribers
methods.description: Exports an immutable copy of the current set of subscribers.
